news.titleEn: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 post best day in a month, Nasdaq jumps as rate-hike fears ease
news.conclusionEn: US stocks rallied on Sept. 3, with the Dow up 624 points (1.18%) to 53,686, the S&P 500 up 1.06% to 7,747.71 and the Nasdaq up 1.4% to 26,584, after Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaled he could support holding rates steady and Treasury yields pulled back.
news.conclusionZh: 9月3日美股大涨，道指涨624点（1.18%）至53686，标普500涨1.06%，纳指涨1.4%，美联储理事沃勒暗示可能支持按兵不动、美债收益率回落。
news.whyEn: The rebound shows how tightly equities are now tied to Fed rate expectations and the bond market; a softer hike outlook eases pressure on stock valuations, mortgages and corporate borrowing worldwide.
news.whyZh: 反弹显示股市已高度绑定美联储加息预期和债市，加息概率下降缓解了全球股票估值、房贷和企业融资的压力。
news.detailEn: Waller said he is prepared to leave the federal funds rate at its current 3.50%-3.75% range at the Sept. 15-16 meeting as long as recent disinflation holds. Fed funds futures now price roughly even odds of a September hike, down from about 70% earlier in the week, and the 10-year Treasury yield fell to around 4.75% from near its highest since 2023. The Dow's gain was its largest single session since Aug. 4. Attention now turns to Friday's August jobs report and next week's inflation data.
news.detailZh: 沃勒表示，只要近期通胀回落趋势延续，他准备在9月15至16日会议上将联邦基金利率维持在当前3.50%-3.75%区间。期货市场目前对9月加息的押注约为五五开，低于本周早些时候的约70%，10年期美债收益率从接近2023年以来高点回落至约4.75%。道指涨幅为8月4日以来单日最大。市场焦点转向周五的8月就业报告和下周的通胀数据。

news.titleEn: Fed Governor Waller indicates he will support holding rates steady at September meeting
news.conclusionEn: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Sept. 3 he is willing to keep the policy rate unchanged at the Sept. 15-16 meeting if progress toward the 2% inflation goal continues, but would consider a rate hike if August inflation data comes in hot.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储理事沃勒9月3日表示，若通胀继续朝2%目标回落，他愿在9月15至16日会议上维持利率不变，但若8月通胀数据偏高则会考虑加息。
news.whyEn: Waller is an influential voice on the rate-setting committee, and his comments shifted market pricing away from a near-certain hike, moving global borrowing costs and currency markets in the process.
news.whyZh: 沃勒在利率决策委员会中颇具影响力，其表态令市场从「几乎笃定加息」转向观望，牵动全球借贷成本和汇市。
news.detailEn: The current federal funds target range is 3.50%-3.75%, unusually high after a long tightening spell tied to the energy-price shock from the US-Iran conflict. Waller framed the decision as data-dependent, with the next two weeks of inflation and jobs figures decisive. Traders dialed back September hike odds to roughly 50-50 from about 70%. A divided Fed now faces the September meeting with the August CPI report and Friday's payrolls as the swing factors.
news.detailZh: 当前联邦基金目标区间为3.50%-3.75%，在美伊冲突引发能源价格冲击、长期收紧后处于偏高水平。沃勒称决策取决于数据，未来两周的通胀和就业数据是关键。交易员将9月加息概率从约70%下调至五五开。分歧中的美联储将带着8月CPI报告和周五就业数据走向9月会议。

news.titleEn: August 2026 jobs report: Payrolls projected up 53,000
news.conclusionEn: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the August employment report on Friday, Sept. 4, at 8:30 a.m. ET, with economists expecting a gain of about 53,000 nonfarm payrolls and the unemployment rate holding at 4.1%.
news.conclusionZh: 美国劳工统计局将于9月4日周五上午8:30（美东时间）公布8月就业报告，经济学家预计非农新增约5.3万人，失业率维持在4.1%。
news.whyEn: The report is the last major data point before the Fed's Sept. 15-16 decision; a weak print supports a rate hold, while an upside surprise could revive hike expectations and jolt bond and stock markets.
news.whyZh: 该报告是美联储9月15至16日决议前最后一份重磅数据，疲软将支持按兵不动，超预期则可能重燃加息押注、冲击股债市场。
news.detailEn: July payrolls fell by 23,000 and the prior two months were revised down by a combined 103,000, leaving June and July with a net loss of about 3,000 jobs. Average hourly earnings are seen rising about 0.2% month over month. The ISM services index came in at 55.4, a sign of steady activity. Analysts describe a labor market that is neither booming nor collapsing, giving the Fed room to wait.
news.detailZh: 7月非农减少2.3万人，前两个月合计下修10.3万人，令6、7月合计净减约3000个岗位。平均时薪预计环比涨约0.2%。ISM服务业指数为55.4，显示活动平稳。分析师形容劳动力市场既不过热也未崩塌，给美联储留出观望空间。

news.titleEn: Brent oil price above $96 per barrel after Iran fires missiles at Kuwait
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude traded around $95-$96 a barrel and WTI near $91 on Sept. 3 after Iran fired missiles at Kuwait, with oil up more than 7% on the week as US-Iran military strikes revived fears over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 9月3日布伦特原油报约95-96美元、WTI逼近91美元，此前伊朗向科威特发射导弹；美伊互相打击重燃霍尔木兹海峡航运担忧，油价本周涨超7%。
news.whyEn: Roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes through Hormuz, so a sustained risk premium in crude feeds directly into inflation, fuel prices and central-bank rate decisions everywhere.
news.whyZh: 全球约五分之一海运石油经霍尔木兹海峡，持续的原油风险溢价直接推升各国通胀、燃油价格和央行利率决策。
news.detailEn: Despite the strikes, more than 17 million barrels of oil transited Hormuz on Monday, a wartime record, moving under US military protection, versus about 20 million barrels a day before the war began on Feb. 28. Analysts say prices are likely to stay elevated while tanker traffic remains exposed to attack. The oil spike is the main driver of the recent surge in global bond yields and of renewed inflation worries facing the Fed and European Central Bank.
news.detailZh: 尽管遭到打击，周一仍有超过1700万桶原油在美军护航下通过霍尔木兹海峡，为战时纪录，而2月28日开战前日通行量约2000万桶。分析师称，只要油轮通行仍面临袭击风险，油价就可能维持高位。油价飙升是近期全球债券收益率上行、以及美联储和欧洲央行面临通胀担忧重燃的主因。

news.titleEn: Broadcom delivers strong earnings but soft guidance sends shares lower
news.conclusionEn: Broadcom reported fiscal Q3 revenue of $29.6 billion (up 86% year over year) with AI semiconductor sales up 221% to $16.7 billion, now 56% of revenue, but the stock fell about 4%-6% after a Q4 revenue guide of $34.8 billion narrowly missed the $35.05 billion consensus.
news.conclusionZh: 博通财季营收296亿美元（同比增86%），AI芯片收入增221%至167亿美元、占总营收56%；但第四季度营收指引348亿美元略低于350.5亿美元的市场预期，股价跌约4%-6%。
news.whyEn: Broadcom is a bellwether for custom AI chips bought by cloud giants, so even a slight guidance miss raises questions about the pace of the AI spending boom just as higher yields pressure expensive tech stocks.
news.whyZh: 博通是云巨头定制AI芯片的风向标，即便指引小幅不及预期，也令人质疑AI支出热潮的节奏，而收益率上升正打压高估值科技股。
news.detailEn: It was Broadcom's ninth straight quarterly earnings beat, but revenue topped consensus by only about 0.5%. Q4 gross margin is guided to 73%, down from 78% a year earlier, as lower-margin custom accelerators and high-bandwidth memory grow as a share of sales. Management still projects fiscal 2026 AI chip revenue near $58 billion and reiterated a path toward roughly $115 billion in fiscal 2027. The results landed alongside a blockbuster AI server report from Dell, underscoring strong infrastructure demand even as investors turn selective.
news.detailZh: 这是博通连续第九个季度盈利超预期，但营收仅高出市场预期约0.5%。第四季度毛利率指引为73%，低于去年同期的78%，因低毛利的定制加速器和高带宽内存占比上升。管理层仍预计2026财年AI芯片收入约580亿美元，并重申2027财年有望达约1150亿美元。该财报与戴尔强劲的AI服务器业绩同期公布，表明基础设施需求旺盛，但投资者转趋挑剔。

news.titleEn: Chevron to expand Venezuela operations, doubling production through $7 billion investment
news.conclusionEn: Chevron agreed to invest more than $7 billion over five years to more than double output from its Venezuelan joint ventures to about 600,000 barrels a day, winning new acreage in the Orinoco Belt including the Carabobo 1 and Carabobo-2-South-A fields.
news.conclusionZh: 雪佛龙同意五年内投资逾70亿美元，将其委内瑞拉合资项目产量翻倍以上至约每日60万桶，并获得奥里诺科重油带包括Carabobo 1和Carabobo-2-South-A两个油田的新区块。
news.whyEn: Chevron is the only US oil major operating in Venezuela, and the deal signals a warming of US-Venezuela energy ties that could add meaningful barrels to global supply over the next several years.
news.whyZh: 雪佛龙是唯一在委内瑞拉运营的美国石油巨头，该协议标志着美委能源关系回暖，未来数年或为全球供应增添可观产量。
news.detailEn: The company said it can keep total costs below $20 a barrel. US Energy Secretary Chris Wright, speaking in Venezuela on Sept. 2, said oil deals worth tens of billions of dollars are central to stabilizing the country and creating jobs. The expansion comes as war-driven supply fears keep crude near $95, and additional Venezuelan output would take years to reach the market. The agreement deepens Chevron's existing Petroindependencia joint venture, in which it holds a 49% stake.
news.detailZh: 公司称可将总成本控制在每桶20美元以下。美国能源部长克里斯·赖特9月2日在委内瑞拉表示，价值数百亿美元的石油协议对稳定该国、创造就业至关重要。此次扩张正值战争引发的供应担忧令油价维持在约95美元，而委内瑞拉新增产量需数年才能进入市场。该协议深化了雪佛龙持股49%的Petroindependencia合资项目。

news.titleEn: Campbell's forecasts weak year ahead on pressured consumer spending
news.conclusionEn: Campbell's shares fell more than 6% on Sept. 3 after the company projected fiscal 2027 net sales down 2% to 4% and adjusted EPS of $1.65-$1.80, below estimates, and cut its quarterly dividend 36% to $0.25 while announcing a $500 million cost-cutting plan.
news.conclusionZh: 金宝汤9月3日股价跌超6%，公司预计2027财年净销售额下滑2%至4%、调整后每股收益1.65-1.80美元，均低于预期，并将季度股息削减36%至0.25美元，同时公布5亿美元成本削减计划。
news.whyEn: Campbell's weak outlook and dividend cut are a fresh signal that lower- and middle-income US consumers are pulling back on packaged food, a warning sign for the broader consumer-staples sector.
news.whyZh: 金宝汤的疲弱展望和股息削减，再度显示美国中低收入消费者正减少包装食品支出，对整个必需消费品板块是警示信号。
news.detailEn: Fiscal Q4 revenue of $2.1 billion missed the $2.15 billion forecast, organic sales fell 1%, adjusted EBIT dropped 25% and adjusted EPS fell 37%, driven by persistent weakness in the snacks division. CEO Mick Beekhuizen said 'our results remain unacceptable' and pledged to address 'reality head-on.' The company aims to cut leverage from 4.3 times to about three times and reach $500 million in savings by fiscal 2030. The stock has badly lagged the market this year.
news.detailZh: 第四财季营收21亿美元，低于21.5亿美元预期；有机销售额下滑1%，调整后息税前利润降25%，调整后每股收益降37%，主因零食部门持续疲软。首席执行官米克·贝克赫伊曾称「我们的业绩仍不可接受」，承诺「直面现实」。公司计划将杠杆率从4.3倍降至约3倍，并在2030财年前实现5亿美元成本节约。该股今年远跑输大盘。

news.titleEn: Mortgage rates hit a new high for 2026, marching closer to 7%
news.conclusionEn: The average US 30-year fixed mortgage rate rose to about 6.71% this week, its highest since July 2025, as a volatile bond market, elevated oil prices and inflation fears push borrowing costs toward 7% ahead of the fall homebuying season.
news.conclusionZh: 本周美国30年期固定房贷平均利率升至约6.71%，为2025年7月以来最高；债市波动、油价高企和通胀担忧推动借贷成本在秋季购房季前逼近7%。
news.whyEn: Mortgage rates near 7% further freeze an already slow US housing market, reducing home sales and refinancing and squeezing household budgets in the largest part of the economy.
news.whyZh: 接近7%的房贷利率进一步冻结本已低迷的美国楼市，抑制房屋成交和再融资，挤压占经济最大份额的家庭预算。
news.detailEn: The 10-year Treasury yield, which mortgage rates track, recently hit a 20-month high before easing on Waller's rate-hold comments. Analysts tie the bond sell-off to Middle East strikes lifting oil and inflation expectations, plus a US gross national debt above $40 trillion. Some daily rate trackers already show quotes near 6.89%. Fewer homes are changing hands and refinance activity has cooled sharply as buyers wait for relief that may not come until the Fed's path is clearer.
news.detailZh: 与房贷利率挂钩的10年期美债收益率近期触及20个月高点，后因沃勒的按兵不动言论回落。分析师将债券抛售归因于中东袭击推高油价和通胀预期，以及美国国债总额突破40万亿美元。部分每日利率追踪已显示报价接近6.89%。房屋成交减少，再融资活动大幅降温，购房者在等待可能要到美联储路径明朗才会出现的缓解。

news.titleEn: China's Xi visits Egypt for the first time in a decade
news.conclusionEn: Chinese President Xi Jinping made a three-day state visit to Egypt starting Sept. 1, his first in ten years, holding talks with President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and calling for Middle East countries to reshape the region's security order and oppose 'unilateralism and acts of bullying.'
news.conclusionZh: 中国国家主席习近平9月1日起对埃及进行为期三天的国事访问，为十年来首次，与总统塞西会谈，呼吁中东国家重塑地区安全秩序、反对「单边主义和霸凌行径」。
news.whyEn: The visit signals China's push for deeper economic and security influence in the Middle East at a moment when US standing in the region has been damaged by its war with Iran.
news.whyZh: 此访显示中国在美国因对伊朗战争而地区威望受损之际，正推动在中东扩大经济和安全影响力。
news.detailEn: China has invested more than $10 billion in Egypt, including a new administrative hub east of Cairo and an electric rail line, with annual bilateral trade around $20 billion. Egypt is seeking closer ties with Beijing while preserving its long-standing relationship with Washington. Xi also visited the Grand Egyptian Museum near Giza. Analysts see the trip as part of a broader Chinese effort to position itself as an alternative partner across the Global South.
news.detailZh: 中国在埃及投资已超100亿美元，包括开罗以东的新行政中心和一条电气化铁路，双边年贸易额约200亿美元。埃及在维持与华盛顿长期关系的同时寻求与北京走近。习近平还参观了吉萨附近的大埃及博物馆。分析人士认为此行是中国在「全球南方」将自身定位为替代伙伴的更广泛努力的一部分。

news.titleEn: Russia air strikes on Ukraine kill 12 as Kyiv hunts for Patriots
news.conclusionEn: Russian air attacks killed at least 12 people and injured many more in Kyiv and the surrounding region in early September, in what has become a sixth straight day of intense strikes, prompting European officials to scramble for more air-defense systems for Ukraine.
news.conclusionZh: 9月初俄罗斯空袭在基辅及周边地区造成至少12人死亡、多人受伤，已是连续第六天的密集打击，促使欧洲官员紧急为乌克兰寻找更多防空系统。
news.whyEn: The intensified bombardment, more than four years into the war, keeps a geopolitical risk premium in energy and grain markets and raises pressure on European governments to fund additional military aid.
news.whyZh: 开战四年多后的加剧轰炸，令能源和粮食市场维持地缘风险溢价，并加大欧洲各国政府追加军援的压力。
news.detailEn: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the barrages used jet-powered drones and ballistic missiles against sites across the capital, including a rail depot and residential buildings. Kyiv is pressing allies for more Patriot interceptors as stockpiles run low. The war has already contributed to this year's spike in oil prices and is weighing on President Trump's Republicans ahead of the November US midterm elections. US-led efforts to broker a ceasefire have so far produced no breakthrough.
news.detailZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基称，袭击使用喷气动力无人机和弹道导弹打击首都各处目标，包括一处铁路站场和住宅楼。基辅正敦促盟友提供更多「爱国者」拦截弹，因库存告急。这场战争已助推今年油价飙升，并在11月美国中期选举前拖累特朗普所在的共和党。美国主导的停火斡旋迄今没有突破。

businessTips.explanationEn: The flywheel effect, popularized by Jim Collins, describes how sustained success comes not from one dramatic move but from many consistent pushes in the same direction that compound over time. Each turn of the wheel is hard at first, but momentum builds, and eventually the business seems to move almost on its own. The practical value is that it forces leaders to identify the handful of reinforcing activities where effort feeds back into more growth, rather than chasing disconnected initiatives. It also builds discipline: you keep pushing the same wheel instead of restarting a new one every quarter.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「飞轮效应」由吉姆·柯林斯提出，指的是持续的成功并非来自某个惊天动地的举动，而是来自朝同一方向许多次一致的推动，随时间不断累积。飞轮的每一圈起初都很费力，但势能会逐渐积累，最终业务仿佛能自己转动。它的实用价值在于：迫使管理者找出那几项相互强化、投入能反馈出更多增长的活动，而不是追逐彼此脱节的新项目。它也培养纪律性——你不断推同一个飞轮，而不是每个季度重新启动一个新的。
businessTips.exampleEn: A subscription coffee brand identifies its flywheel: better beans lead to happier customers, who leave reviews and refer friends, which raises order volume, which lets the company buy beans in larger lots at higher quality and lower cost, which improves the product again. Instead of launching a new product line every few months, the team spends a full year just tightening those four steps, and growth accelerates without a bigger marketing budget.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家订阅制咖啡品牌梳理出自己的飞轮：更好的咖啡豆带来更满意的客户，客户留下评价并推荐朋友，从而提高订单量，使公司能以更大批量采购、品质更高且成本更低的咖啡豆，进而再次改进产品。团队没有每隔几个月推出新产品线，而是用整整一年只打磨这四个环节，结果在没有增加营销预算的情况下增长加速。

businessTips.explanationEn: A productized service packages custom work into a fixed offer with a set scope, set price and repeatable process, so it is sold and delivered more like a product than a bespoke project. Instead of quoting every client separately, you offer something like 'one landing page per week for a flat monthly fee.' This makes marketing simpler, cash flow more predictable, and delivery something you can eventually document and delegate. For a side hustle it is often the fastest path from trading hours for money to building an asset, because the clear scope protects your limited time.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「产品化服务」是把定制工作打包成范围固定、价格固定、流程可复制的标准方案，让它像产品而非一次性项目那样被销售和交付。你不再对每个客户单独报价，而是提供类似「每月固定费用、每周产出一个落地页」的方案。这让营销更简单、现金流更可预测，交付流程最终也可以写成文档并外包。对副业而言，这往往是从「用时间换钱」走向「打造资产」的最快路径，因为清晰的范围能保护你有限的时间。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance designer who juggles unpredictable one-off jobs switches to a productized offer: '$1,500 per month for unlimited design requests, one active task at a time, 48-hour turnaround.' Clients know exactly what they get, she knows exactly what she owes, and after three months she hires a junior designer to handle first drafts using a checklist she wrote, turning the service into something that runs without her full attention.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由设计师原本疲于应付零散的一次性活儿，改推产品化方案：「每月1500美元，无限次设计需求，同一时间处理一个任务，48小时交付。」客户清楚知道能得到什么，她也清楚知道该交付什么。三个月后，她按照自己写的清单雇了一名初级设计师负责初稿，让这项服务不再需要她全程盯着。

businessTips.explanationEn: An expense ratio is the annual fee a fund charges, expressed as a percentage of the money you have invested in it. A 0.05% expense ratio costs $5 a year per $10,000 invested; a 1.0% ratio costs $100 for the same amount. Because the fee is charged every year on your whole balance, small differences compound into large gaps over decades, often far outweighing any short-term performance edge a pricier fund advertises. Checking the expense ratio before buying is one of the few investment decisions that is almost entirely within your control.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「费用率」是基金每年收取的管理费，以你投入其中的资金的百分比表示。0.05%的费用率意味着每投入1万美元每年花费5美元；1.0%的费用率则对同样金额收取100美元。由于这笔费用每年都按你的全部余额收取，微小的差异在数十年里会复利成巨大的差距，往往远超一只更贵的基金所宣传的任何短期业绩优势。买入前查一下费用率，是少数几乎完全由你自己掌控的投资决定之一。
businessTips.exampleEn: Two investors each put $10,000 into funds tracking the same index and add nothing more. One fund charges 0.04%, the other 0.85%. Assuming both earn 7% a year before fees for 30 years, the low-cost fund grows to roughly $75,000 while the higher-cost fund reaches only about $59,000, a gap of around $16,000 created purely by fees on otherwise identical holdings.
businessTips.exampleZh: 两位投资者各拿1万美元买入追踪同一指数的基金，之后不再追加。一只基金收费0.04%，另一只收费0.85%。假设两者扣费前都年化7%、持有30年，低成本基金增长到约7.5万美元，而高成本基金只有约5.9万美元，约1.6万美元的差距完全由费用造成，而两者持仓其实完全相同。
